summary: Translate the wrong committed against the addressee, rather than a mistaken opinion of him
before: Since I was mistaken in you
rationale: The Turoyo clause is liʔanno ġaləṭno b-ḥaq diḏux. The edition renders it “Denn ich habe einen Fehler gegen dich begangen”, consistent with the preceding request for forgiveness. English “I was mistaken in you” instead says that the speaker misjudged the addressee.
